assessment_scope: Installed Ultralytics8.3.40 source inspection and isolated CPU BCE gradient semantics; NOT installed custom ignore support or a second runnable training route.

source_inspection.observation: v8DetectionLoss assigns positives with TAL then applies BCE over every anchor/class, no ignore mask. Deleting ignore labels trains unknown targets as negatives.
Format consumes cls and Instances; native arbitrary ignore coordinates are not propagated by a sidecar file through letterbox, flip, affine, mosaic and collate.
Detector validator matches known GT then includes all remaining predictions in precision/confusion matrices; no uncertain-region neutralization.

requirements_if_ever_switching.positive_priority: Run ordinary TAL assignment on confirmed bodies; never feed ignore boxes as a class/positive. valid_anchor = fg_mask OR NOT in_transformed_ignore. Keep every assigned positive and its original all-class BCE, bbox and DFL even when overlapping ignore.
requirements_if_ever_switching.background_policy: Suppress all class BCE only for unassigned anchor centers inside padded source-ignore regions, source-truncated/unsupported bodies and unparented uncertain emitters. Center policy does not promise suppression for centers outside the region and requires real leak/false-negative analysis.
requirements_if_ever_switching.normalization: Retain normal max(target_scores.sum(),1) positive normalization; zero retained background must be finite. Do not scale down true positives based on ignore area.
requirements_if_ever_switching.augmentation_coordinates: Carry pixel xyxy regions with per-image IDs through exact same resize, letterbox padding, horizontal flip and batch collate as pixels. Disable mosaic/mixup/copy_paste/affine/perspective initially. Any future geometry needs joint clipping plus explicit treatment of newly truncated known bodies; silent box filtering would make false background.
requirements_if_ever_switching.validation_rules: Match predictions to known GT first at every evaluated IoU threshold; any matched known positive stays TP. For remaining unmatched predictions, a preregistered ignore-overlap rule (e.g. intersection/predicted_area >=0.5) makes them neutral, never TP. Known GT denominator remains unchanged. Apply same rule to AP, precision/recall and confusion matrices, and report neutralized detections/area separately. Threshold sensitivity and unmatched duplicate predictions require audit.
requirements_if_ever_switching.required_evidence: End-to-end actual-source dataset/augmentation/batch coordinate tests; gradient tests with actual TAL positives; actual forward/backward; exact no-ignore equivalence; positive-over-ignore priority; transformed-edge and mixed-batch cases; ignore metric TP/FP/FN tests; independent real-image QA. An export-file change or this algebra probe is insufficient.

decision: Keep the actually validated context-preserving clean-crop standard-YOLO route for this first round. Do not enable or maintain a custom-loss training entry on the strength of a small algebra probe. Address the measured original-count and pedestrian/context shortfall by separately reviewed clean originals; re-evaluate feasibility if those cannot supply a credible dataset.
